text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
It's about time for training, and I'm<n>looking for
Grass Wonder.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Oh dear, I just can't get one in. It<n>must be how I'm
snapping my wrist.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Oh... I'm sorry, Trainer. Is it time for<n>our training
session?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Practicing free throws. I'll be taking<n>part in a
basketball game with my<n>classmates soon.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
And no matter the contest, losing is<n>not an option
for me.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
So I'm sorry, but I do have five<n>minutes until
training, correct?

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
She's not wrong, so I wait as she<n>spends those
last five minutes<n>practicing furiously. By the end of
our<n>actual training, she's completely<n>wiped.
